_doc: QC hard-core recipes for gen_core_kit_qc.py (claude/qc-cores-1024). Closed views: physical/ref_tile/<kit>/views (closed geometry = LEF pin contract; plan pins files are QC-P6 provisional 'io' tables). spec from the closed record's source commit when the ref_tile spec is not in the tree. RTL = closed source (blob-identical at the closed commit) + the decision-13 reset patch.

rtl_patches.why: OWNER DECISION 13 hard-core reset contract: rst_n is a SYNCHRONOUS registered input at the data IO budget; the internal async 2-flop synchroniser (rl0/rl1 or rs0/rs1, async clear on rst_n) becomes a synchronous 2-stage relay of the same release depth (assertion synchronous, release cycle unchanged). Downstream flops keep their async clear from the relay output (timed recovery/removal).
edits:
reg rs0, rs1;   // QC-CORES kit patch (OWNER DECISION 13): synchronous 2-stage relay on the registered rst_n input
    always @(posedge ck)
        if (!rst_n) begin rs0<=1'b0;rs1<=1'b0;end
qfd_dv_su8_kff #(.W(4*AW), .ID(670 + gc)) u_pin (.ck(ck), .d(xs_raw), .q(xs_pin));

assign xs_pin = {c_si[109:86], c_si[182:159], c_si[255:232], c_si[341:318]};   // QC-CORES kit patch: was 8 per-lane pin replicas of si (face_guard shared 96: ONE pin register per input bit); c_si = the u_input_pins register of the same edge, 0 cycles, bit-exact

ot_qwen_tile_romleaf.insertion_basis: 12.3 common core latency 250 TT / 202.5 FF kit frame (preflight corner_modes/ff_binding); parent A0 early tap absorbs the centre-entry trunk (QC-A0-KITS-2 est, UNCHECKED)
ot_qwen_tile_romleaf.two_mode_why: QC-A0-KITS-7 10-28 TT-slew root cause: the FF-only GRT step loads only the FF liberty, so the post-GRT DRV repair never saw TT slews (a0k5 AP 1662a1bff39e: DRV TT 23 / FF 5, all else passing). Two-mode staging (kit_modes.py stage, gen_core_kit_hbm form) repairs DRV with TT and FF libraries in the GRT session. Probe on the a0k5 kit (CHECKED): SIGNED, TT +147.25, FF hold +4.16, DRV 0. Built with --seam-hold 25,25 (COORD 19:44/19:54 ruling).
ot_qwen_tile_romleaf.cts_args_why: QC-A0-KITS-5 10-28 ROMLEAF plan fix: the ROM clock pin is a CTS sink balanced with its LIB insertion delay (OpenROAD TritonCTS default: macro insertion from max/min_clock_tree_path arcs; -no_insertion_delay NOT set). ot_rom_4096x266_m8 LIB/rom_gen declares no clock_tree_path arc (internal control latency is inside clk->q; setup/hold are referenced at the pin) -> insertion 0, the ROM pin balances to the register tree. -delay_buffer_derate 1.0 = full macro/register latency balance (was the generator default 0.5 = half, ROM 80-115 ps early in a0k3).
ot_qwen_tile_romleaf._why: QC-A0-KITS-7 10-28: a0k7s = a0k5 plan + two_mode (TT-slew root cause) + --seam-hold 25,25. QC-A0-KITS-5 10-28: clock entry to the logic corner (21.612,15.12) (slice note) + full ROM latency balance (cts_args). QC-A0-KITS-3 10-28: romleaf re-kit on current main, frame 250/202.5, clock entry (86.412,98.4) M5 in the top band off the ROM (COORD 06:37 ruling (a)). QC-A0-KITS 10-27: romleaf re-kit on the current flow with the 12.8a centre clock entry (86.4,55.08) from the A0 R3b slice (was clk W edge 0,21.756); OBS <= M5 (LEF unchanged M1-M5); outline 172.8 x 110.16 unchanged.
